tuning.why: The recap parts under about 90s (10 Cloverfield Lane parts 1–8 at 58–85s, plus Fall parts 2–4) drew most of the recap views, while the 158–190s Blink Twice recaps averaged far less, so 165 is a single 30s step toward shorter parts.
The 165 s change was followed by Elysium parts 2–7 (165–288 s) drawing 2 views total, while the sub-90 s recap parts drew the most, so I moved the length down one 30 s step to 135 s.

Elysium parts 2–7 (165–288 s), posted after the Oct 29 change to 165 s, drew 2 views total while sub-90 s Cloverfield and Fall recap parts drew 300–490 each, so I'm stepping down 30 s to 105 s; the Nov 4 change to 135 has no posts since to judge it by.

ai.summary: The channel has 104,531 views but holds attention poorly: 8.3s average watch and 3.1% full watch, so most viewers leave in the first seconds. Recap parts with a tag-a-friend hook carry almost all of the views, and the 165-second Elysium batch was the clearest failure, which the owner has already moved back to 105 seconds.
working: Recaps drive the channel: 34 recap videos made 45,540 of 104,531 views (1,339 per video, vs 199 for highlights and 116 for stretch).
Elysium part 1 with a 'Tag someone who needs to see this' hook drew 33,000 views, 18.4s average watch, 8.8% full watch and 80 saves, the channel's best.
The 'I like banana' Part 12 video drew 56,000 views at 35.8% full watch, the best retention on the channel.
Highlights hold attention longer: 14.9s average watch vs 6.5s for recaps; Predestination highlights reached 14.3s and 7.2% full watch.
not_working: Elysium parts 2-7 (165-288 s), posted after the Oct 29 change to 165 s, drew 2 views combined.
Speak No Evil averages 2.6s watch and 0.5% full watch across 8 parts (1,489 views total).
Overall average watch is 8.3s and full watch 3.1%, so the first seconds of each part are losing viewers.
Stretch is the weakest mode at 116 views per video and 5.5s average watch.
actions: Keep recap parts at 105 seconds and judge the next 5 posts on avg_watch and full_watch before changing length again.
Open each recap part with a bold hook and end it on a question or cliffhanger, copying the 'Tag someone' line that worked on Elysium part 1.
Fill in the movie and mode fields for the 'I like banana' Part 12 video (56,000 views, 35.8% full watch) so the channel can learn from it.
Download Verity and Shutter Island first, then test a highlights series on a twist film to compare retention against recaps.
